verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents payouts/disbursements from a custodial account to onchain wallet addresses, email recipients, or bank accounts via API/CLI (coinbase-payments-docs-3, -20, -23), and provides webhook-based real-time status notifications for wallet activity (coinbase-payments-docs-15, -16, -24) that can be used to track settlement. Missing for 10: an explicit 'stored recipient' object/API reference and a documented payout status/lifecycle schema (e.g., pending→settled states) showing final settlement confirmation.
